summary: Tectonic Therapeutic filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a press release with favorable Phase 1a topline safety, tolerability and pharmacokinetic results for TX2100, an APJ-targeting antibody for hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia. The FDA granted Fast Track designation and cleared the Phase 1b IND. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date is stated. This is an ordinary clinical-update current report, not a special situation; risk-arb focus centers solely on clinical and regulatory milestones, not deal terms.
